text: This report recommends approval of the re-naming of Ramsden Park Road to "Ramsden Park Lane” This naming proposal complies with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy which can be found at https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/street-naming/ .

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the renaming of Ramsden Park Road to "Ramsden Park Lane" as shown as Part 1 in Attachment 1 to the report (May 28, 2026) from the Director, Engineering Support Services, Engineering and Construction Services.
